target.section: Acceptance Criteria / US-003: Apply refusals, archive and manifest / criterion 13

action.newText: [unit] When the outbox stub throws on its first enqueue, the snapshot of <archiveDir>/<id>/manifest.json captured at that failure boundary before rollback has status: "applying", the plan's retired and merged, provider, model, notesBefore and fillBefore, and no created. After handled rollback, the manifest has status: "rolled_back".

rationale: This resolves the spec's intermediate-state versus final-state inconsistency without weakening archive or rollback requirements.

target.section: Acceptance Criteria / US-010: Compaction prompt builder / criterion 11

action.newText: [unit] buildMemoryCompactPrompt returns text that says feedback and user notes are never candidates and only listed slugs may be named in retire.slug or merge.from, while merge.into.slug may be a valid new target under the validator's collision rules.

rationale: The PRD resolves an internal spec contradiction and preserves the specified merge capability.

action.newText: [unit] compactProjectMemory returns { kind: "invalid", reasons } with validateMemoryCompactionPlan's reasons when the plan merges into an existing note's slug that is not one of that merge's own from slugs, and does not call confirm. Reusing one of that merge's own from slugs is not rejected as a target collision.

rationale: Orchestration must apply the same collision semantics as deterministic validation and locked apply.

target.section: Acceptance Criteria / US-019: Run summary lines / criterion 9

action.newText: [unit] Given refusedFull > 0 and a nearly-full host index, close() logs, in order, the save-count line, the refused line and the nearly-full line, and then closes the host.

rationale: This makes the ordering criterion consistent with the spec's conditional reporting requirements.

rulingTitle: A mirror has an `outbox/entry.json` symlink whose target cannot be read; `readdir` succeeds, but `Dirent.isFile()` is false, so `outboxCount` skips it without adding the path to `unreadable` and the mirror may be prunable.

action.instruction: In US-021, before enabling prune, update outboxCount in packages/nax/src/memory/mirrors.ts to mark non-regular .json entries, including dangling or unreadable symlinks, in unreadable rather than silently skipping them. Do not follow symlinks. Add inventory regressions asserting these mirrors are not prunable, and a CLI regression proving --prune --yes never removes them. Preserve existing regular-entry counts and .json.tmp exclusion.

rationale: Verified: outboxCount filters on Dirent.isFile(), silently excluding symlinks; isPrunableMirror then accepts an otherwise empty mirror with unreadable: []. This violates conservative empty-outbox pruning. US-021 introduces deletion and must close this safety gap before using the inventory to remove mirrors. Existing acceptance tests do not require symlink entries to be ignored.
